# undermine

> Weaken, cause to collapse by digging away at the foundation (of a building or an argument); injure or attack in a secretive or underhanded way

> weaken or sabotage, often subtly


## Example

- *The student undermined the teacher's authority by questioning the teacher's judgment on numerous occasions.*
